convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom indicator (ColorHMA) and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic, making it impossible to auto-convert without reimplementing the custom indicator and library functions.

derived_values.name: Sqrt_Period - integer square root of HMA_Period
derived_values.used_by: min_rates_total calculation and implicitly by ColorHMA internal WMA calculation

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

other_exits: Sell positions closed when ColorHMA turns upward (Value[1]<Value[2]); Buy positions closed when ColorHMA turns downward (Value[1]>Value[2])

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input value (0.1) is interpreted differently depending on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads 3 consecutive ColorHMA buffer values at indices SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2 (via CopyBuffer with count=3 starting at SignalBar). Trend direction is determined by comparing Value[1] vs Value[2] (two older values). Entry trigger additionally requires Value[0] vs Value[1] confirmation (most recent value continuing the direction). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are input booleans that gate whether each type of trade is allowed. BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose/BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen are functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh that handle actual order placement and position management. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit to clean up global variables used by the trade algorithm library. Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on first tick or after CopyBuffer failure.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement ColorHMA (Hull Moving Average) indicator: HMA = WMA(2*WMA(close, n/2) - WMA(close, n), sqrt(n)). The three-buffer comparison logic (Value[0], Value[1], Value[2]) for trend+entry detection needs careful indexing. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) must be reimplemented with proper position checking, margin calculation based on MarginMode, and order execution with deviation. The conditional position sizing (5 modes via MarginMode) requires implementing each mode's lot calculation. SignalBar parameter allows backtesting on confirmed bars (SignalBar=1) vs current bar (SignalBar=0).
